**Yes. CAPA-26-012 and CAPA-26-015 trace back to the same upstream cause: the INC-03 incubator door closure fault, specifically the door switch that was never corrected.**

The two CAPAs come from different deviations with different recorded root causes:

- **CAPA-26-012** (corrective: replace the INC-03 door switch and re-execute TC-OQ-INC-04) comes from **DEV-26-011**. That deviation's recorded root cause is "door switch misaligned." During OQ, the INC-03 door-open alarm sounded at 142 s against a 60 s limit.
- **CAPA-26-015** (corrective: retrain Suite 2 operators on the door latch check, SOP-MFG-105) comes from **DEV-26-033**. That deviation's recorded root cause is "operator did not confirm door latch per SOP-MFG-105." It affected PPQ26-02, whose harvest viability was 75.2% against the 80% criterion.

The records link the two. The equipment log shows the INC-03 door alarm on 10 June at 21:40, acknowledged at 07:50 the next morning. The INC-03 temperature trace fell from about 36.2 °C to about 33.5 °C overnight, and a temperature-low alarm followed. PPQ26-02 was expanded in INC-03, and the deviation found the door "not fully latched."

The upstream fault was never fixed. Change control CC-26-019 (INC-03 door switch replacement and TC-OQ-INC-04 re-execution) was approved but is still "APPROVED – NOT IMPLEMENTED." **Yes. CAPA-26-012 and CAPA-26-015 trace back to the same upstream cause: the INC-03 incubator door closure fault, specifically the door switch that was never corrected.**

The two CAPAs come from different deviations with different recorded root causes:

- **CAPA-26-012** (corrective: replace the INC-03 door switch and re-execute TC-OQ-INC-04) comes from **DEV-26-011**. That deviation's recorded root cause is "door switch misaligned." During OQ, the INC-03 door-open alarm sounded at 142 s against a 60 s limit.
- **CAPA-26-015** (corrective: retrain Suite 2 operators on the door latch check, SOP-MFG-105) comes from **DEV-26-033**. That deviation's recorded root cause is "operator did not confirm door latch per SOP-MFG-105." It affected PPQ26-02, whose harvest viability was 75.2% against the 80% criterion.

The records link the two. The equipment log shows the INC-03 door alarm on 10 June at 21:40, acknowledged at 07:50 the next morning. The INC-03 temperature trace fell from about 36.2 °C to about 33.5 °C overnight, and a temperature-low alarm followed. PPQ26-02 was expanded in INC-03, and the deviation found the door "not fully latched."

The upstream fault was never fixed. Change control CC-26-019 (INC-03 door switch replacement and TC-OQ-INC-04 re-execution) was approved but is still "APPROVED – NOT IMPLEMENTED." CAPA-26-012 is still OPEN, past its 31 March 2026 due date. DEV-26-033 was closed with the operator-error root cause, and CAPA-26-015 (retraining only) was closed with its effectiveness check still PENDING. The retraining addresses the symptom, not the equipment fault.

I checked the other CAPAs and found no link to this cause:
- CAPA-26-016 (from DEV-26-027) relates to donor CD3% variability. Engineering run ENG26-01 ran in INC-02, not INC-03, and its CD3% was in line with the PPQ batches.
- CAPA-26-008 (FRZ-80-02 compressor) and CAPA-26-019 (tubing supplier defect) have separate causes.
